name: Old Gerlind
notes: Grandmother, 70s, casts the beech-wood lots. Thusnelda's sister. Speaks to the box, not the people.
gm_notes: Saw the spear pass through as a girl ('You ate my father'). Estranged from Thusnelda (11 years without speaking his name). Her words repeated to Thusnelda at the South stones make him waver.
objective: Keep her brother from dying for the wrong reason.
goal: Make the Romans understand what they carry.
agenda: Casts lots at the PCs' feet; talks to the box.
secret: She still loves her brother and has never told him.
